question: Should portable-v2 archives exclude the new sync-failure ledger, or intentionally retain a redacted and declared form of it?
rationale: The current patch silently retains full operational error text outside the portable store's declared metadata contract, and choosing whether that state is publishable is a security and compatibility policy decision.

options.title: Exclude from portable stores
options.body: Drop `sync_attempt_failures` during portable pruning and keep the full ledger only in local writable archives.

options.title: Retain a redacted ledger
options.body: Strip or sanitize error messages, declare the capability in portable metadata and documentation, and add upgrade and publication tests.

options.title: Accept full ledger publication
options.body: Explicitly document that portable stores include complete hydration error history and accept the resulting disclosure risk.

recommendation.title: Exclude from portable stores
recommendation.body: Drop `sync_attempt_failures` during portable pruning and keep the full ledger only in local writable archives.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant portable-v2 contract and pruning implementation trace directly to his commit.
